chapter.heading: Zechariah 13
chapter.v: 13“On that day there shall bea fountain opened for the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and uncleanness.

“Andon that day, declares the Lord of hosts,I will cut off the names of the idols from the land, so thatthey shall be remembered no more. And also I will remove from the land the prophets and the spirit of uncleanness.
‘You shall not live, for you speak lies in the name of the Lord .’ And his father and mother who bore him shall pierce him through when he prophesies.
every prophet will be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies. He will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive,
‘I am no prophet, I am a worker of the soil, for a man sold me in my youth.’
And if one asks him, ‘What are these wounds on your back?’ he will say, ‘The wounds I received in the house of my friends.’
I will turn my hand against the little ones.
and one third shall be left alive.
and they will say, ‘The Lord is my God.’”

footnotes.footnote: 13:5 Or *for the land has been my possession since my youth*
13:6 Or *on your chest*; Hebrew *wounds between your hands*
